    Vt100StatusLine
    The Vt100StatusLine type builds the thin status line for the VT100 console.
    Vt100TokenWindow
    The Vt100TokenWindow type counts tokens for the VT100 console.
    Vt100TokenWindow.Book
    The Book type holds the Roux lines for this window, one chat per user.
    Vt100TokenWindow.Line
    The Line type is one Roux message.
    Vt100TokenWindow.Tally
    The Tally type is the used-token count, the character count, and the message count for one chat.
    WordWrap
    The WordWrap type hard-wraps text at spaces.
